_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); home-improvement retail signals

pit_profile.why: Lowe's: the world's second largest home improvement retailer, 1,832 home improvement and hardware stores in the U.S., Canada and Mexico with approximately 200 million square feet, serving do-it-yourself, do-it-for-me and professional customers; its sales follow housing turnover and the activity level of home improvement projects (its own 10-K), the franchise does not

classification.quality_note: Lowe's: the world's second largest home improvement retailer, 1,832 home improvement and hardware stores in the U.S., Canada and Mexico with approximately 200 million square feet, serving do-it-yourself, do-it-for-me and professional customers; its sales follow housing turnover and the activity level of home improvement projects (its own 10-K), the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 1.24x; +40% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.26; conservative 2yr +29%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -19.9%/yr (worst year FY04-FY13, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +17.5%/yr (FY14 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +17.5%/yr (FY04-FY13 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +22.3%/yr (best 2-yr run FY04-FY13); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LOW (retrospective, 2014-07-18) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.24x (49.8% downside to Bear $24 / +40.1% upside to Bull $67) | Adj composite 2.28 vs market 2.54: gap -0.26 [MODESTLY OVERVALUED] | +40% above the EPP floor $34 (13x FY14E $2.63) | Conservative 2-yr case: +28.7% total (+14.4%/yr) | At 18.2x FY14E the 15% hurdle price $63 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; comps +0.9% in Q1 FY14, forward sales +5% (FY14 sales guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.

sources.title: Lowe's Companies FY2013 10-K
sources.supports: selected financial data 2009-2013, income statement 2011-2013 with percent of sales, 2013 diluted shares 1,061M, interest $476M, income tax provision $1,387M on pre-tax $3,673M; cash, short-term investments, operating cash flow, capital expenditures; product-category sales (regrouped, prior years reclassified); $3.7B repurchased in 2013, $6.3B authorization, the 2014 guide assumes about $3.4 billion of repurchases; 2013 fourth-quarter dividend $0.18; 1,832 home improvement and hardware stores (72 Orchard stores acquired 2013-08-30), approximately 200 million square feet

sources.title: Lowe's Companies FY2012 10-K
sources.supports: selected financial data 2008-2012, income statement 2010-2012 with percent of sales, 2012 diluted shares 1,152M, interest $423M, income tax provision $1,178M on pre-tax $3,137M; cash, short-term investments, operating cash flow, capital expenditures; product-category sales (regrouped, prior years reclassified); $4.35B repurchased in 2012, $5.0B authorization remaining, the 2013 guide assumes about $4 billion of repurchases; 2012 fourth-quarter dividend $0.16; comparable store sales renamed comparable sales (a comparable location open longer than 13 months); 1,754 stores in the U.S., Canada and Mexico, 197 million square feet

sources.title: Lowe's Companies FY2011 10-K
sources.supports: selected financial data 2007-2011 (fiscal 2011 has 53 weeks), income statement 2009-2011 with percent of sales, 2011 diluted shares 1,273M, interest $371M, income tax provision $1,067M on pre-tax $2,906M; cash, short-term investments, operating cash flow, fixed assets acquired; product-category sales; $2.9B repurchased in 2011, $4.5B authorization remaining; 2011 fourth-quarter dividend $0.14; 1,745 stores in the U.S., Canada and Mexico, 197 million square feet, 27 stores closed

sources.title: Lowe's Companies FY2010 10-K

sources.title: Lowe's Companies FY2009 10-K

sources.title: Lowe's Companies FY2006 10-K (annual report, exhibit 13)
